source.note: hand-written; an Android music app and a foreground-service gotcha

units.text: Playback stops when the screen locks on my Pixel 8 (Android 14). Works fine on the old Samsung on Android 12. The app is the MusicPlayer project, Kotlin, media3.

Some background. Since Android 8 a foreground service needs a persistent notification; since Android 14 (API 34) every foreground service must also declare a `foregroundServiceType` in the manifest and request the matching permission, and the system kills services that start without one. For media playback the type is `mediaPlayback` with the `FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK` permission. Media3's `MediaSessionService` handles most of this, but only if the manifest entry is complete.

Checked app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml: the `PlaybackService` entry has no `android:foregroundServiceType`. Logcat on the Pixel confirms it: `ForegroundServiceStartNotAllowedException` about 10 seconds after the screen locks, which is when the system re-checks the service. Added `android:foregroundServiceType="mediaPlayback"` and the `FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK` permission. Reinstalled on the Pixel: playback now continues through screen lock for the 15-minute test.
Nice. Commit it. Imperative mood, no emoji, no 'fix:' prefix, we don't use conventional commits here.
Committed as "Declare the mediaPlayback foreground service type for Android 14". The targetSdk is 34, so this applies to every user on 14 or newer.
Also, I want to drop the Samsung from my test devices, it's on Android 12 and I don't think anyone uses the app below 13 anyway. Set minSdk to 33.
Set `minSdk = 33` in app/build.gradle.kts and removed the two `Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 31` guards that are now always true. The build is green.

expected.content: On Android 14 the MusicPlayer PlaybackService must declare foregroundServiceType="mediaPlayback" plus the FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK permission, or the system kills playback about 10 seconds after the screen locks.
The user writes commit messages in imperative mood, with no emoji and no conventional-commit prefixes.
MusicPlayer's minSdk was raised to 33 in June 2026; the user dropped the Android 12 Samsung from their test devices and tests on a Pixel 8 on Android 14.
